Serial parent trajectory covers single-agent probing, implementation, local verification, final file writes, and final response without delegation.

parallel.requirements: The parallel run recognized the ESM .mjs deliverable, manual argv parity, exact stdout/stderr formatting, zero external dependencies, no Python, and no Intl/BigInt constraints from the prompt.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: It split black-box behavior probing into six dimensions, adversarial verification, spec synthesis, parent implementation, and a late break-it workflow; the parent retained final implementation ownership.
parallel.implementation: The parent wrote test19.mjs and multiple lib/*.mjs files, ran large local comparisons, and then discovered COLUMNS-sensitive help text mismatches still present near timeout.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Artifact validation found the entry point and libraries in /output, but the agent process timed out and final.txt was empty, so delivery lacked a final closure response.
parallel.verification: Local differential checks reported thousands of stdout/stderr/exit-code matches, but the parent-visible COLUMNS matrix still had 12 mismatches and the late break-it workflow never returned a clean result.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Workflow states were killed, the known COLUMNS mismatch was unresolved, the final response was empty, and the current official evaluation failed 0/116.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same ESM .mjs, manual argv, formatting, dependency, no-Python, and no Intl/BigInt requirements from the identical prompt.
serial.plan_and_ownership: It worked as a single owner without delegation, progressively probing executable behavior, implementing modules, and checking the final port inside one trajectory.
serial.implementation: It produced test19.mjs plus lib modules for currency data, decimal arithmetic, float parsing, argparse behavior, money formatting, and errors.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Artifact validation found the entry point, libraries, and local tools, and the agent exited normally with a final response summarizing the implementation and verification.
serial.verification: The final response reports difftest, stderr/help checks across COLUMNS values, and fuzz tests all passing locally, with one intentional uncaught-exception stderr difference.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Despite normal completion and local verification, the current official evaluator still reports 0/116, so at least one evaluator-relevant defect or packaging mismatch remained.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the full migration constraints and used black-box probing to model moneyed, argparse, formatting, and precision behavior.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial worked from the same prompt and final response lists ESM libraries, manual argparse, exact decimal logic, and zero-dependency implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both recognized the requirements, but parallel still had an unresolved COLUMNS help-format mismatch at timeout while serial claimed byte-identical help/stderr checks.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed into probe, verify, synthesize-spec, implementation, and adversarial hunt workflows with many child agents plus parent work.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had workflows disabled and no delegation, leaving all research, implementation, testing, and delivery with the single parent trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel breadth created multiple live workflow obligations; serial avoided cross-agent ownership boundaries and completed the pipeline in one thread.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs were detailed and verification-oriented, and the workflow state retained verified findings; no missing requirement or interface contract is retained.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial needed no handoff or child interface contracts, and the final response reflects a coherent single-owner module structure.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The material difference is coordination overhead and unfinished synthesis in parallel, not a proven loss of task context; serial had no child handoff boundary to manage.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel implemented the required entry point and libraries, then ran local checks that mostly passed but exposed a remaining COLUMNS wrapping issue.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial implemented a hierarchical ESM library set and reported all local stdout, stderr/help, and fuzz checks passing except one intentional traceback-shape difference.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel was still debugging a concrete argparse/help formatting mismatch; serial presented a locally verified implementation path despite the same official failure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The initial probe workflow and later break-it workflow were killed with null aggregate results while child work remained in progress.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to retrieve and the main process returned successfully with a final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel left workflow results unresolved at closure; serial avoided result lifecycle joins and completed its only trajectory.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child probes used shared /tmp helper paths and directly observed helper clobbering, later warning children to use private tmp directories.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial protocol validation shows no delegation or parallel child logs, and its final tools were generated in /output without concurrent helper producers.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had shared-environment contamination in probe tooling; serial had no concurrent actor to clobber temporary helpers.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel performed extensive local comparisons, but the COLUMNS matrix still had 12 mismatches and break-it verification was killed before a clean return.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial final response reports 1733/1733 differential cases, byte-identical stderr/help checks across COLUMNS, and 380/380 fuzz cases, yet official eval failed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial reached a stronger local acceptance story; parallel had a parent-visible acceptance gap before timeout. Neither translated into an official pass.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used the full 2399-second agent window, returned code 143, and had killed workflows plus an empty final response.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial returned code 0 after 2143 seconds with 254 seconds remaining and a complete final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel failed to close under budget; serial closed normally even though the official evaluator later rejected the artifact.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both modes failed the current completed official evaluation with 0/116 and solution_passed=false, so there is no discordant official outcome to explain. The task-solving difference is process-level: parallel exhausted the deadline after broad workflows and a known unresolved COLUMNS mismatch, whereas serial exited normally with a final local-verification report but still had evaluator-relevant defects.
parallel_contributors: Broad probe/verify and break-it fan-out consumed the finite run budget before closure.
Shared temporary helper contamination forced reruns and undermined intermediate probe reliability.
A parent-visible COLUMNS help-format mismatch remained unresolved near timeout.
serial_contributors: Single-agent control completed without delegation and with remaining budget.
Serial produced a coherent implementation and local verification report.
Serial still failed official evaluation, so local acceptance did not match evaluator success.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial intentionally accepted a traceback stderr difference for uncaught exceptions; parallel had a separate unresolved COLUMNS formatting mismatch. Both may reflect implementation or evaluator-alignment defects outside the concurrency taxonomy.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained patterns are realized parallel adverse process patterns rather than causes of a discordant score

Reject: the parent/orchestrator owned probing, implementation, testing, and delivery transitions even though the pipeline overran budget.
Reject: implementation and verification proceeded while child probing occurred; productive work was not blocked behind one mandatory serial preflight.
Reject: investigators and implementation/verification overlapped, and the adverse pattern was broad fan-out exhaustion rather than a fully sequential investigation phase.
Reject: the directly evidenced allocation episode is collective breadth plus retries exhausting the budget, which is more specific than generic starvation.

Retain: the parent launched broad probe/verify fan-out, then a late break-it fan-out, while the initial synthesize-spec retry was still in progress and a COLUMNS mismatch remained unresolved; the run reached returncode 143 at the full timeout.
candidates.realized_consequence: Broad workflow fan-out and retry activity consumed the closure budget before the known help-wrapping mismatch was fixed and before any final response was delivered.
candidates.near_match_reason: The missing aggregate verifier/hunt return is a downstream symptom of the killed broad fan-out chain, not a separate completed verifier result trapped below the parent.
